name: X Factor
description: X Factor is the Italian version of the British musical talent show The X Factor. The first four seasons aired on Rai 2, but since 2011 it has been broadcast on Sky Uno, with reruns on TV8, after Rai dropped the show due to high costs. Sky Italia acquired the format, extending its broadcast until 2024. Starting from the eleventh season, RTL 102.5 became the official radio station, replacing Radio Deejay and Radio 105. The show was hosted by Francesco Facchinetti (2008-2010), Alessandro Cattelan (2011-2020), Ludovico Tersigni (2021), and Francesca Michielin (2022-2023). From 2024 onwards, Giorgia will take over as host. Since the seventh season, the show has been produced by Fremantle Italia without the collaboration of Magnolia, which had produced the selection episodes in the early seasons.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 1
videos.overview: X Factor starts again: the boys must win the votes of Fedez, Ambra, Morgan and Dargen. Francesca Michielin leads the way.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 2
videos.overview: The selections for #XF2023 continue, Fedez, Ambra, Morgan and Dargen are ready to listen to new talents.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 3
videos.overview: X Factor reaches the 3rd episode of Auditions: the contestants have the last chance to conquer Fedez, Ambra, Dargen and Morgan.

videos.title: Bootcamps - Part 1
videos.overview: The chairs are ready. The first two judges discover which of the aspiring contestants they will have to choose to move forward, between difficult decisions and painful choices.

videos.title: Bootcamps - Part 2
videos.overview: The X Factor Bootcamps continue. Just one performance is enough to earn one of the five chairs. Who will be able to access the next step?

videos.title: Last Call
videos.overview: Just one step before the Live of #XF2023. Fedez, Ambra, Morgan and Dargen are called to choose the artists who will form their respective teams.

videos.title: Live 1
videos.overview: All set for the X Factor Live: the 12 contestants who passed the selections perform in front of Fedez, Dargen, Ambra and Morgan. Hosted by Francesca Michielin.

videos.title: Live 2
videos.overview: The contestants perform in front of the judges of the seventeenth season of the musical talent show, Ambra, Fedez, Dargen and Morgan. Which contestant will return to the competition after the repechage?

videos.title: Live 3
videos.overview: The challenge continues on the X Factor stage where the contestants perform in front of the judges Ambra, Dargen, Morgan and Fedez. Guests: Colapesce Dimartino.

videos.title: Live 4
videos.overview: The fourth Live of X Factor opens with the carousel round. The contestants will have to overcome the Hell Factor, a double elimination episode. Super guest: Annalisa.

videos.title: Live 5
videos.overview: The eight remaining contestants perform with songs assigned by Ambra, Fedez and Dargen. In the second round, Max Pezzali will also judge them on his songs.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: It's time for the semi-final: the contestants perform accompanied by an orchestra and then finally present their unreleased songs. Guests: Emma Marrone.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 1
videos.overview: The new edition of X Factor is starting! The aspiring contestants must win the votes of the new judges: Achille Lauro, Jake La Furia, Paola lezzi and Manuel Agnelli. Giorgia will host X Factor 2024.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 2
videos.overview: The selections for X Factor 2024 continue. The judges of the new edition Paola, Jake, Achille and Manuel are ready to listen to new talents. To continue dreaming, at least three yeses are needed.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 3
videos.overview: The contestants have one last chance to win over Paola, Jake, Achille, and Manuel and advance to the Bootcamp.

videos.title: Bootcamps - Part 1
videos.overview: This year, there are only four chairs per team available for the aspiring contestants! Let’s find out who will be chosen by the first two judges.

videos.title: Bootcamps - Part 2
videos.overview: The X Factor Bootcamp continues: just one performance to earn one of the four chairs. Who will make it to the next round?

videos.title: Home Visits
videos.overview: Just one step away from the live shows of #XF2024. Paola, Achille, Manuel, and Jake must choose the artists who will form their teams.

videos.title: Live 1
videos.overview: The X Factor Live stage lights up: the 12 contestants perform in front of Manuel, Jake, Paola, and Achille. Giorgia hosts the show.

videos.title: Live 2
videos.overview: 11 contestants remain in the competition. 4 judges to evaluate them and a host to lead the show, Giorgia.

videos.title: Live 3
videos.overview: The challenge continues on the X Factor stage, where the contestants perform in front of the judges: Manuel, Jake, Paola, and Achille. Guests: Tananai and SARAFINE.

videos.title: Live 4
videos.overview: Carousel round for the fourth X Factor Live: contestants must face the Hell Factor, a double elimination. Special guest: Negramaro.

videos.title: Live 5
videos.overview: Originals night at #XF2024! The 7 contestants must win over the judges and the audience to survive another elimination. Guest: Coma_Cose.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: It’s semifinal time: the contestants perform with an orchestra and face another double elimination. Guest: Gazzelle.

videos.title: Finals
videos.overview: Live from Naples for the first time, the X Factor finale features Mimì, I PATAGARRI, Les Votives, and Lorenzo Salvetti battling it out. Who will win? Special guest: Robbie Williams.

videos.title: Auditions 1
videos.overview: X Factor kicks off! The aspiring contestants must win the votes of judges Achille Lauro, Jake La Furia, Paola Iezzi, and Francesco Gabbani. Hosting the show is Giorgia.

videos.title: Auditions 2
videos.overview: The auditions for #XF2025 continue. Paola, Jake, Achille, and Francesco are ready to listen to new talents.

videos.title: Auditions 3
videos.overview: The aspiring contestants have one last chance to win over Paola, Jake, Achille, and Francesco and gain access to the Bootcamps.
